unchanged_rules: late if lag_seconds > 900; late does not mean invalid
no operator_email or raw_payload in release
batch_policy: All inherited row rules and input-byte checks must pass before any write. An invalid incoming revision batch is rejected as a whole, not repaired by reverting to older versions within the batch.
change_scope: Validated observation revisions only. No business deletes, CDC tombstones, sensor registry changes or automatic schema evolution.
single_writer: One Spark driver per table at a time; serial task commands.
benchmark_exclusion: Never put expanded benchmark rows into operational Bronze/Silver/Gold.
retention: Do not run VACUUM or delete files/logs referenced by any approved release.
